explanation: This method is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because .format(numberOfLinks) embeds numberOfLinks directly into the LIMIT clause inside self.cursor.execute(). Untrusted input in numberOfLinks could alter the SQL query to extract unauthorized records. The repair introduces a '?' placeholder, but passes bare scalar numberOfLinks instead of a 1-tuple (numberOfLinks,), which causes a parameter-binding error in standard sqlite3 drivers.
